workflow: A shared callable object exposes mutable dispatch state used by concurrent invocations.
One worker lazily changes that dispatch state when selecting a fallback execution path.
Another worker reads the same state to dispatch a call without synchronization or atomic coordination.
The concurrent read and write form a data race, which diagnostic instrumentation reports and causes the instrumented run to fail.
summary: Unsynchronized dispatch-state mutation during concurrent calls
decision_reason: The bug is materially the same as concurrent unsynchronized mutation of shared native state during use: one thread changes a shared handle-like dispatch value while another reads it.
